title: Registration & Palette: Wire Up New Node Types
description:
Register the 3 new node types in the ReactFlow canvas and update the builder sidebar palette.

**Files (MODIFY):**

1. `dashboard/src/components/workflow/WorkflowCanvas.tsx`
   - Add to `nodeTypes` object: `'agent-task': AgentTaskNode, 'pack-action': PackActionNode, 'tool-call': ToolCallNode`
   - Keep `job: AgentTaskNode` as backward-compat alias (old workflows loaded from backend may have type "job" before transform runs)
   - Import the 3 new nodes from `./nodes`

2. `dashboard/src/components/workflow/BuilderSidebar.tsx`
   - Replace the single "Job" (Briefcase) entry in `NODE_TYPES` with 3 entries:
     - `{ type: "agent-task", label: "Agent Task", icon: MessageSquare, color: "text-blue-500" }`
     - `{ type: "pack-action", label: "Pack Action", icon: Package, color: "text-violet-500" }`
     - `{ type: "tool-call", label: "Tool Call", icon: Wrench, color: "text-amber-500" }`
   - Group these 3 under an "Agent & Actions" category header
   - Keep existing entries (Approval, Delay, Condition, Notify, Fan-out) grouped under "Flow Control" / "Human" categories
   - Import MessageSquare, Package, Wrench from lucide-react

3. `dashboard/src/components/workflow/nodes/index.ts`
   - Already handled in task 2, but verify exports are present

**Depends on:** Task 2 (node components).
